_comment: Layout scope and device realization for layout/lna_core (issue #63). Read by generate.py (what to draw) and layout/lvs_reference.py (what the LVS reference contains). 'in_scope' maps each design/netlist/lna.spice instance this bring-up draws to the PDK PyCell that realizes it; 'out_of_scope' lists every other instance with the reason it is not drawn. lvs_reference.py fails if the two lists do not partition the netlist exactly, so a netlist change cannot silently fall out of both.

nx.meaning: npn13G2 emitter count (Nx) of the cascode pair. Issue #58's emitter-array decision lands as a change to this one value (generate.py --nx), not a redraw. Q3 stays Nx=1: DR-0003's island is a density match to Q1 at the netlist's own Nx=8 ratio, so changing nx without re-sizing the island is a design change this script does not make on its own.

XQ3.role: DR-0003 bias island: diode-connected density-match reference

R3b.role: DR-0003 bias island: bref -> b1 coupling resistor
R3b.realization_note: Schematic value is an ideal 330 ohm. Realized as rppd w=1u l=1.005u; the PyCell's own model-formula readout for that geometry is r=329.74 ohm (PyCell TEXT label, which includes the PDK's end resistance Rzspec). This choice is a layout-time realization, not a re-sizing of the design.

Cbref.role: DR-0003 bias island: RF ground of the bref node
Cbref.realization_note: Schematic value is an ideal 100 pF. Realized as 16 parallel cmim units of 64.5 x 64.5 um: 16 x (4160.25 um^2 x 1.5 fF/um^2 + 258 um x 0.04 fF/um) = 100.0 pF at the cap_typ coefficients. cmim's own Cmax is 8 pF per instance, hence the bank.

XMis.role: DR-0003 island feed: 12.8:1 mirror bank copying I_ref into bref
XMis.realization_note: Schematic is ng=1 w=512u; drawn as 32 fingers of 16u (same total W, same L). The fingers' gates are tied by a GatPoly bus generate.py draws; the netlist's single device corresponds to 32 parallel layout devices.

out_of_scope.Le: matching / degeneration inductor: no SG13G2 inductor model exists (design/README.md caveat 1, klayout-tools#1519); matching-network work is #27/#56
out_of_scope.Cin: input coupling cap: part of the input match (#27)
out_of_scope.Cout: output coupling cap: part of the output match (#27)
out_of_scope.Cbyp2: cascode-base (vb2) bypass cap: belongs with the R2a/R2b divider, not drawn in this bring-up
out_of_scope.Cvdd: supply decoupling cap: a pad-ring / supply-network item, not this bring-up
out_of_scope.R2a: cascode-base bias divider (vb2): left as a port of this cell
out_of_scope.R2b: cascode-base bias divider (vb2): left as a port of this cell
out_of_scope.Rseed: DR-0003 reference core (Stage-1 skeleton startup seed)
